panels.title: Agreement % (1h)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Share of ledgers over the last hour where this validator agreed with the network consensus.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of the 1-hour agreement percentage.*

###### Reading it:
*Higher is better; green at 95%+, yellow from 80%, red below.*

###### Healthy range:
*95-100%.*

###### Watch for:
*Values below 80%, meaning the validator frequently disagrees with consensus.*

###### Keywords:
- **Consensus** — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.
- **Validation agreement** — the share of ledgers where this validator's validation matched network consensus versus was missed.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`registerValidationAgreementGauge`

###### References:
[Consensus](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure) · [Validation agreement](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure#validation) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#consensus)

panels.title: Agreement % (24h)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Share of ledgers over the last 24 hours where this validator agreed with consensus.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of the 24-hour agreement percentage.*

###### Reading it:
*Higher is better; a smoother, longer-term view than the 1h stat.*

###### Healthy range:
*95-100%.*

###### Watch for:
*A sustained dip below 90%, which can indicate configuration drift or a network partition.*

###### Keywords:
- **Validation agreement** — the share of ledgers where this validator's validation matched network consensus versus was missed.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

panels.title: Agreements vs Missed (1h)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Counts of agreed versus missed validations over the last hour.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge readings of the 1-hour agreed and missed counts.*

###### Reading it:
*Agreements should dominate; missed should be small.*

###### Healthy range:
*Missed near 0.*

###### Watch for:
*A high missed count, meaning the validator is skipping consensus rounds.*

###### Keywords:
- **Validation agreement** — the share of ledgers where this validator's validation matched network consensus versus was missed.
- **Consensus round** — one propose-and-revise iteration of consensus; several may run before validators converge on a ledger.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`registerValidationAgreementGauge`

panels.title: Validation Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Validations this node sends per minute.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of the sent-validations counter over 5 minutes, scaled to per minute.*

###### Reading it:
*Should track the ledger close cadence; roughly one validation per closed ledger.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 12-20 per minute (one per closed ledger, ~3-5s close).*

###### Watch for:
*A drop toward zero, meaning the validator has stopped participating.*

###### Keywords:
- **Validations checked vs sent** — validations this node received from peers and checked, versus validations it issued itself.
- **Ledger close interval** — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`incrementValidationsSent (caller RCLConsensus.cpp)`

###### References:
[Validations checked vs sent](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure#validation) · [Ledger close interval](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/ledgers/ledger-close-times) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#validations-checked-vs-sent)

###### Reading it:

###### Healthy range:
*Workload-dependent; scales with trusted validator count.*

###### Watch for:
*A sudden collapse, which suggests peer connectivity loss or network isolation.*

###### Keywords:
- **Validations checked vs sent** — validations this node received from peers and checked, versus validations it issued itself.

panels.title: Amendment Blocked

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of the amendment-blocked flag.*

###### Reading it:
*OK is healthy; BLOCKED means an enabled amendment is unsupported by this build.*

###### Healthy range:
*OK.*

###### Watch for:
*A BLOCKED state, which halts validation and requires a software upgrade.*

###### Keywords:
- **Amendment blocked** — the node has halted because the network enabled an amendment its software version does not support.

panels.title: UNL Expiry (days)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Days remaining until the current UNL (trusted validator list) expires.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of days-to-expiry.*

###### Reading it:
*Higher is safer; green at 30+, yellow under 7, red at expiry.*

###### Healthy range:
*30+ days.*

###### Watch for:
*Fewer than 7 days, after which the node loses its trusted validator set if not renewed.*

###### Keywords:
- **UNL (Unique Node List)** — the list of validators a node trusts not to collude; the basis for its consensus and quorum.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`registerValidatorHealthGauge`

###### References:
[UNL (Unique Node List)](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/unl) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#unl-unique-node-list)

panels.title: Agreement/Missed Counters (Rate)
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Rate of cumulative agreement and missed-validation counters per minute.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of each monotonic counter over 5 minutes, scaled to per minute.*

*Agreements should dominate; the missed line should stay low.*

###### Healthy range:

panels.title: Validation Quorum
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Minimum number of trusted validations required to declare a ledger fully validated.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of the current quorum requirement.*

###### Reading it:
*Tracks the quorum derived from the active validator list; changes when the list changes.*

###### Healthy range:
*Stable at the network-appropriate value.*

###### Watch for:
*An unexpected drop, which can weaken consensus safety guarantees.*

###### Keywords:
- **Validation quorum** — the minimum number of agreeing trusted validations needed to declare a ledger fully validated.
- **Validator list** — signed lists of recommended validators (UNLs) that peers distribute to each other.
- **Consensus** — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`registerValidatorHealthGauge`

###### References:
[Validation quorum](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/negative-unl) · [Validator list](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/unl) · [Consensus](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#validation-quorum)

panels.title: State Value Timeline
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Numeric encoding of the server operating state (disconnected, connected, syncing, tracking, full, validating, proposing) over time.*

###### How it's computed:
*Instantaneous gauge reading of the encoded state value.*

###### Reading it:
*A flat line at the full-operation state is healthy; steps show transitions.*

###### Healthy range:
*Steady at the highest (full) state.*

###### Watch for:
*Frequent transitions, useful for correlating state flapping with other metrics.*

###### Keywords:
- **Operating mode / server state** — the node's sync level: Disconnected, Connected, Syncing, Tracking, Full (and Validating/Proposing).
- **Consensus mode** — the node's role/health in the current round: Proposing, Observing, Wrong Ledger, or Switched Ledger.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)

###### Function:
`registerStateTrackingGauge`

###### References:
[Operating mode / server state](https://xrpl.org/docs/references/http-websocket-apis/api-conventions/xrpld-server-states) · [Consensus mode](https://xrpl.org/docs/concepts/consensus-protocol/consensus-structure) · [Telemetry glossary](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/docs/telemetry-glossary.md#operating-mode-server-state)

panels.title: State Changes Rate

*Rate of server operating-state changes per hour.*

###### How it's computed:

###### Reading it:
*Near zero is healthy; each increment is one state transition.*

###### Healthy range:
*Near 0 changes per hour.*

###### Watch for:
*Frequent transitions, which point to network instability or configuration problems.*

###### Keywords:

panels.title: Ledgers Closed Rate
panels.description:
###### What this is:
*Ledgers closed per minute by this node.*

###### How it's computed:
*Per-second rate of the ledgers-closed counter over 5 minutes, scaled to per minute.*

###### Reading it:
*Should match the network's steady close cadence.*

###### Healthy range:
*About 12-20 per minute (one per closed ledger, ~3-5s close).*

###### Watch for:
*Deviation from the expected cadence, which indicates consensus timing trouble or the node falling behind.*

###### Keywords:
- **Ledgers closed rate** — how many ledgers this node closed per minute; should match the network close cadence.
- **Ledger close interval** — the network's steady ledger rhythm — roughly one closed ledger every 3-5 seconds on Mainnet.
- **Consensus** — the protocol by which validators agree on the next ledger's transaction set and close time.

###### Source:
[MetricsRegistry.cpp](https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/telemetry/MetricsRegistry.cpp)
